nom: Personal Day Doing The Work Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment

segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive skin is the most reported segment: reviewers consistently say this is one of the few salicylic acid treatments that doesn't irritate, dry out, or upset their sensitive skin, several calling it the first one that hasn't caused a reaction.
segments.dry: Reviewers whose skin normally dries out easily with acne treatments report this one is a rare exception, treating breakouts without the dryness or itching other products caused, including one with eczema-prone dry skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with cystic acne reports her skin became noticeably less oily as her breakouts cleared with consistent use.

concerns.blemishes: The overwhelming majority of reviewers report fewer, smaller, or faster-healing breakouts, including with hormonal, cystic, and perioral acne, with several describing individual pimples visibly shrinking overnight; a couple of reviewers are more measured, saying their skin is clearer overall but they didn't feel it specifically prevented new breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: A striking number of reviewers, including several with dry or eczema-prone skin, specifically praise the treatment for not drying out or flaking their skin the way other acne treatments have, some calling it the first salicylic acid product that didn't leave them dry and itchy; one reviewer notes mild irritation only when she applied more than the recommended amount.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers specifically credit the treatment with reducing redness and inflammation from active breakouts, describing calmer-looking skin within days; the only dissent is one reviewer who noticed slight irritation when she applied more product than recommended.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report post-acne marks, scars, and hyperpigmentation fading with continued use, in addition to the treatment's effect on active breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with cystic acne reports her skin became noticeably less oily as her breakouts cleared with consistent use.

aspects.libelle: Extremely strong alcohol-like smell for some

extraits.texte: This is the stinkiest smelliest toner I've ever used. Have you ever taken a shot? Well this smells like pure raw nasty rail vodka. I can't even tell you if it works, I can't continue to use it. I will return immediately bc I am GAGGIng at how this smells on my face

I have eczema so my skin can be really dry but I also get acne as well on occasion which as a female in her 30's can be a little annoying and embarrassing. I came across Lili's brand when I watched her Go To Bed With Me Harper's Bazar video and I ordered this toner. I LOVE this stuff. It actually works, I always put it on at night and the nights that I do, some of the acne has been gone the next morning. A little goes a long way and it doesn't dry or irritate my skin which is a BIG bonus because sadly most products like this do. I highly recommend this product, 100/10!! She really knocked it out of the park with her skincare brand. You can tell she cares by the products she has come out with!

I've been using this for a month and am so happy with the results! I use it every other day, and have seen fewer acne flare ups. Its gentle formula doesn't make my skin itch or peel, and the acne marks and hyperpigmentation seem to benefit from this as well! This is my go-to salicylic acid forever and I'm telling everyone about it!

Azelaic acid is the main reason I've completely fallen in love with this product. After doing extensive research, I discovered that azelaic acid is incredibly effective in preventing the growth of acne-causing bacteria, which has been a game-changer for my skin. It works beautifully to reduce redness, calm inflammation, and smooth out my complexion. Knowing that this ingredient targets the root cause of breakouts gives me so much confidence in its effectiveness. The visible difference I've seen is nothing short of amazing!

extraits.titre: I don't want to be dramatic but I cannot live without this.
extraits.texte: I've been using this for the past year, and it is truly THE BEST. I've always loved Salicylic Acid for my skin, but I had never used Azelaic Acid before and I swear that's the game changer in this. When I have spots, it def helps my acne. If I feel one coming on, it def helps. And it doesn't burn at all, so you know it's not ruining your skin. Also, ever since I've been using this, I get waaaaay less breakouts. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't upset it at all. It only helps. For context: I am a 32 year old female.
For someone whose skin dries easily with these kinds of products, I was happily surprised with how well this product works without overly drying!
I've consistently used this on my cystic acne and it has gotten so much better since. It cleared up quickly and my skin is a lot less oily now.
